title: Personal preferences
intro: Choose colors, fonts and language, then save them separately to this device or your account.
localIntro: Changes appear in the preview. Use the button below to save them on this device.
customHint: Leave blank for theme defaults. Use HEX or rgb(…).
fontNote: Only the font name is saved. Missing fonts fall back to system fonts; no external fonts are downloaded.
previewTitle: Make room for your next idea
previewText: Check colors and text readability here. This is a preview of unsaved changes.
previewNote: Changes currently apply only to this preview.
localSaved: Saved on this device. Your account preferences have not changed.
inputsReset: Restored the values saved on this device.
invalidContrast: The colors need more contrast for readable text and controls. Your input is preserved.
invalidInput: Check your colors using HEX or rgb(…). Your input is preserved.
syncIntro: Loading preferences does not change this device. Review them before applying or saving.
localProfileHint: Sign in to save preferences to your account.
remoteNotLoaded: Account preferences have not been loaded yet.
remoteEmptyHint: Save the current input to load it on other devices.
applyRemote: Apply loaded settings on this device
remoteApplied: Loaded preferences were saved on this device and applied to its appearance.
remoteSaved: Saved to your account. Saving on this device is a separate action.
loadSuccess: Account preferences loaded. Your input and device settings are unchanged.
sessionChanged: Your account changed. Input is preserved and actions are paused. Reload the page and confirm which account to use.
sessionUnavailable: The connection could not be confirmed. Your input is preserved. Please try again later.
localReadError: Saved device settings could not be read. The stored value has not been deleted.
localWriteError: Settings could not be saved on this device. Check browser storage. Your input is preserved.
conflict: Preferences changed on another device. Your input is preserved. Load again and compare before saving.
uncertain: The save result could not be confirmed. Your input is preserved. Load preferences again to check the result.
invalidResponse: The server response could not be verified. Your input and last reviewed settings are preserved.
genericError: The action could not be completed. Your input is preserved. Check the connection and try again.
syncBoundary: Only display preferences are synced. Page content, permissions and server environment settings are excluded.
deviceBoundary: Device settings are stored separately for each signed-in account.
applyHint: Replaces settings saved on this device and the current input with the loaded preferences.
uploadHint: Load account preferences first to review the destination before saving.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
followSystemHint: Use Light for light appearance and Midnight for dark appearance. Turn this off to return to your chosen theme and colors.
